subject.title: [Bug]: Slash command error——WebUI treats `/model status` as a model name instead of a slash-command subcommand

question: Should maintainers adopt/repair the open fork PR for this WebUI fix, or close it and allow a new narrow OpenClaw fix PR?
rationale: The bug and fix shape are clear, but an open closing PR already attempts the repair outside the target repo and is currently conflicting, so automation should not create a duplicate path without maintainer routing.

options.title: Close or supersede the stale fork PR, then queue a narrow fix
options.body: This avoids carrying an old conflicting branch and lets a current-path repair target `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-command-executor.ts` with focused tests.

options.title: Adopt and repair the fork PR
options.body: Maintainers can preserve the contributor's branch intent, but it needs rebasing from old `ui/src/ui/chat` paths and real validation before merge.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork PR
options.body: The issue stays open, but no new repair work should be queued while the conflicting linked PR remains the intended implementation path.

recommendation.title: Close or supersede the stale fork PR, then queue a narrow fix
recommendation.body: This avoids carrying an old conflicting branch and lets a current-path repair target `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-command-executor.ts` with focused tests.
